holder-quote: Ressk was a [Psychic Guardian]. Capable of the same feats as the Minds, on a smaller scale. And Geneva Scala?
A passing [Psychic Guardian], Ressk, turned his head as Geneva and Idis argued.
Selphids? Geneva looked up, and [Psychic Guardian] Ressk stared down at her.
Ressk and the Selphids tried to take Geneva up the stairs, but the Bodies of Fellden and forces in this citadel came down
The [Psychic Guardian] slowed. Ressk passed by an open hallway, and Geneva saw a pulsing orb of Selphids rising.
